description: Search shibaSIM travel eSIM plans for one destination with factual filters. Prices are USD. Each result has a checkout_url that sends the buyer to shibaSIM. Per-day plans are filtered on GB/day, fixed plans on total GB.

data_type.description: Only daily-allowance plans or only fixed total-data plans.

destination.description: Destination name, ISO country code or destination code from list_destinations, e.g. 'Japan' or 'JP'.

five_g.description: true = only plans where 5G is verified on shibaSIM.

hotspot.description: true = only plans that allow hotspot/tethering.

min_data_gb.description: Minimum GB (GB per day for per-day plans, total GB for fixed plans).

sort.description: cheapest = lowest price; value = lowest USD per GB.

name: search_plans
title: Search eSIM plans
